About the Fellowship

Harvard's Ethics and Civics Fellowship supports postdoctoral research connecting ethical scholarship with education and public life. The appointment is based in the Research and Design Studio, with particular attention to disagreement, civic discourse and practical research contributions.

Research Areas

  • Ethics
  • Civics
  • Research and pedagogy

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryUSD 7,000/month, September–June; up to USD 3,000 research allowance
DurationSeptember 2027 to June 2028

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Academic preparationDoctorate completed no more than three years before the fellowship begins.
Further conditionsPhD completed no more than three years before fellowship start; all citizenships.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round15 November 2026
LocationUnited States

About Harvard University

Harvard hosts research fellowships through its academic schools, institutes and centres. Each fellowship has its own research focus, eligibility rules and application process, separate from doctoral admission.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://academicpositions.harvard.edu/postings/16745

Source: academicpositions.harvard.edu - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
